## Executive Summary
Salih Ben Otman is a high-caliber Full Stack Software Developer, UI/UX Engineer, and AI Systems Builder with over 5 years of professional engineering experience. His portfolio spans over 50 completed client and open-source projects, ranging from AI agent systems and real-time collaboration suites to enterprise dashboards and responsive full-stack applications.

He combines rigorous software engineering foundations (algorithmic efficiency, design patterns, clean architecture, database modeling) with elite frontend craft (fluid micro-interactions, responsive ergonomics, accessibility, and high performance).

## Technical Stack & Competencies

### Frontend Engineering
- **Frameworks & Runtimes**: React 19, Next.js 15 (App Router, Server-Side Rendering, Static Site Generation, Server Actions), TypeScript (Strict Mode).
- **Styling & Design Tokens**: Tailwind CSS, PostCSS, Radix UI primitives, shadcn/ui component system, CSS Modules, Responsive ergonomics (mobile-first).
- **Motion & Physics**: Framer Motion / motion/react, GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform with ScrollTrigger), Canvas animations, CSS keyframe optimization.
- **State & Data**: TanStack Query / React Query, React Context, Custom hooks, Optimistic UI updates.

### Backend & Cloud Architecture
- **Server Technologies**: Node.js, Express.js, Next.js Edge Runtime and Node runtime API routes.
- **Databases & ORMs**: Google Cloud Firestore, Firebase Realtime Database, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Prisma ORM.
- **Authentication & Security**: Firebase Authentication (OAuth, Google, GitHub, Custom Tokens, RBAC), Secure HTTP-only cookies, Rate limiting, Input validation (Zod).
- **Storage & CDN**: Firebase Cloud Storage, Vercel Edge Network, Cloudinary media pipeline.

### AI Engineering & LLM Integration
- **Model Providers**: OpenAI (GPT-4o, o3-mini), Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), Google Gemini (Gemini 2.0 Flash / Pro), OpenRouter API multi-model routing.
- **Orchestration & Workflow**: LangChain, Langflow, Autonomous AI Agent Tool use, Prompt engineering, Streaming responses with SSE (Server-Sent Events), JSON-mode structured output.
